title: The fixed raw scalar comparison is invertible
statement: For every commutative Λ, k:W→S, module sheaf G on W, q∈N, U∈S.Etale and A∈Over(W), rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A is an isomorphism of abelian groups. This is componentwise invertibility of the fixed explicit map; no naturality assertion is included.

proof.text: Use class detection to obtain injectivity and class lifting to obtain surjectivity. Combine these into bijectivity and apply ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective to the actual raw additive morphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03FD, class detection and class lifting split; Mathlib concrete-category bijectivity criterion
